descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S04 Quick Dictation matches the p72 prototype's compartment system

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 The build matches the source-of-truth prototype's compartment system (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html, attached to the ticket). (TFA-92582 AC 1)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (ticket attachment) and the local build

When Compare side by side: entry point on the list, full-screen pad, box layout, room chip, 'Matches on your list', Assign / Re-assign, picker, 'New compartment', the 'Nothing is auto-merged' note, delete control, Dictate / Stop

Then Same compartment system: one box per patient, placed only by a tap, nothing auto-merged

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side review against the prototype, each difference listed. Delete control and cross-device pad are Q12

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) (VISUAL (pad states vs p72 side by side)); secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
